text:
mia: heads-up 
 opened a small PR to unify migration notes for SDK v3 -> v4 usage queries, fix a dead grafana link, and add a compact migration snippet + curl example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5512

matt: nice. can you show both the v3 and v4 snippets side-by-side so folks can copy/paste? also include the Authorization header explicitly.

sanjay: add a short note about tier attribution changes in v4: we now use `billing_account_id` for tier lookup (was `account_id` in v3). mention how that affects multi-tenant customers.

mia: good call. draft below: kept minimal. added a short paragraph about billing_account_id behavior and a one-line sample response. also fixed the grafana link to the new dashboard slug.

```python
# SDK v3 (legacy) - returns per-account totals
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
print(c.usage.get(start="2025-12-01T00:00:00Z", end="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"))
# -> [{"account_id":"acct_123","tokens":45231}]

# SDK v4 (migration) - breakdown by tier using billing_account_id
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
print(client.usage.query(start="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", end="2026-02-01T00:00:00Z", breakdown="tier").metrics)
# -> [{"tier":"startup","tokens":12345},{"tier":"enterprise","tokens":98765}]
```

```bash
# curl example (explicit header)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/query \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"start":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-02-01T00:00:00Z","breakdown":"tier","filters":{"product":"embeddings"}}'
```

mia: small paragraph added: "Note: SDK v4 resolves tier labels using billing_account_id. If you previously filtered by account_id in v3, you may see different tier assignments for accounts with shared billing. For migration, run a side-by-side month-of-data compare and file a support ticket if tiers differ unexpectedly."

leo: I trimmed the grafana target and corrected the internal link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/usage-summary?view=tier -> updated to docs example. tiny grafana target: `{"title":"Tiered tokens","targets":[{"expr":"sum by (tier)(redwood_usage_tokens_total{product=\"embeddings\"})","legendFormat":"{{tier}}"}]}`

elaine: please add an FAQ bullet: "Are system/ephemeral tokens included?" Answer: "No, public usage queries filter them out by default. Use internal audit endpoints for raw traces." Also add a line about prorated tier credits (per-second, rounded at billing run) and reserved credits consumption order.

mia: added FAQ bullets. also fixed two internal link anchors that were 404ing. updated PR.

docs-bot: PR updated: mia pushed 2 commits to docs/sdk-migration-usage at 3276543230 
 https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5512/files

qa-bot: smoke tests: curl returns 200 with sample shape, v4 snippet runs in a clean env, grafana panel renders in staging. All good.

matt: LGTM, will merge after CI green. thanks for including the side-by-side and the migration notes, that should cut down support tickets.

mia: thanks all :shipit:
